description: Open-web searches included monthly Canada terms, French terms for Quebec, Montreal, Toronto, and several targeted weeks, but October 8–14 and the final week were not resolved by dedicated, effective date-bounded searches. Search operators may not have honored date windows.
required_followup: Run targeted English/French date-window searches for 8–14 and 22–31 October across additional provinces and local outlets.

description: Regional coverage is concentrated in Montreal and Toronto/Ontario. No systematic local reporting sweep was completed for Atlantic Canada, the Prairies, northern territories, or most BC cities.
required_followup: Search province/city local sources and sector groups; current findings do not support any completeness claim.

description: The 21 October Queen’s Park gathering occurred and opposed Ontario measures, but CityNews describes its crowd only as relatively small, leaving the simultaneous 50-person threshold unresolved.
required_followup: Find a permitted contemporaneous attendance estimate; otherwise retain pending_threshold.

description: A 21 October media advisory announced hospitality-worker actions on 22 October in Toronto, Ottawa and Vancouver seeking government prioritization in bailouts; actual gatherings and attendance were not verified.
required_followup: Search post-event regional reporting or union releases; announcement alone is not event evidence.

description: CityNews says the 17 October Toronto demonstration followed similar recent rallies; another query surfaced a 26 September Toronto event. These are dated actions, not evidence of uninterrupted protest. January boundary and fuller October sequence were not resolved.
required_followup: Check late September and November/January reporting to resolve campaign versus discrete-event scope.

description: Only public open-web searching was used; no LexisNexis-equivalent archive or comprehensive local press corpus was available in this work.
required_followup: Retain as a method limitation; do not infer no other events occurred.
